questions.question: This painting is the most beautiful creation in the entire gallery.

Follow the prescribed safety checklist and unexpected operational hazards may occur.
Unless the prescribed safety checklist is followed, unexpected operational hazards may occur.
Because the prescribed safety checklist is followed, unexpected operational hazards may occur.
questions.solution: Compound mein agar 'or (warna)' wala meaning aaye, toh complex mein meaning same rakhne ke liye 'if….not, unless, lest…..should' se banayenge, isliye 'Unless the prescribed safety checklist is followed, unexpected operational hazards may occur' wala option C sahi hoga.

questions.question: Accelerate the evacuation process, or critical delays could worsen the emergency situation.
options: Accelerate the evacuation process lest critical delays should worsen the emergency situation.
The evacuation process is accelerated although critical delays worsen the emergency situation.
The evacuation process is accelerated, so critical delays worsen the emergency situation.
The evacuation process is accelerated and critical delays worsen the emergency situation.
questions.solution: Compound mein agar 'or (warna)' wala meaning aaye, toh complex mein meaning same rakhne ke liye 'if….not, unless, lest…..should' se banayenge, isliye 'Accelerate the evacuation process lest critical delays should worsen the emergency situation' wala option A sahi hoga.

questions.question: If the financial projections are not reassessed carefully, the organization may face severe budgetary constraints.
options: The financial projections are not reassessed and the organization may face constraints.
Reassess the financial projections carefully, or the organization may face severe budgetary constraints.
The financial projections are not reassessed so that the organization may face constraints.
The financial projections are not reassessed while the organization faces constraints.
questions.solution: Sentence mein 'if……not' se pata chal raha ki complex hai, agar complex mein 'if……not, unless, lest….should' aaya hai, toh iska matlab compound mein 'or (warna)' waali conjunction se bana hoga, toh complex to compound jaana hai, isliye 'Reassess the financial projections carefully, or the organization may face severe budgetary constraints' wala option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: Enhance employee engagement initiatives, and overall workplace productivity will improve.
options: If employee engagement initiatives are enhanced, overall workplace productivity will improve.
Employee engagement initiatives are enhanced, so overall workplace productivity improves.
Because employee engagement initiatives are enhanced, overall workplace productivity improves.
Employee engagement initiatives are enhanced and overall workplace productivity improves.
questions.solution: Jab compound mein 'and' conjunction 'reason' 'result' ko joda ho, toh complex mein meaning same rakhne ke liye 'if' conjunction se banayenge, isliye 'If employee engagement initiatives are enhanced, overall workplace productivity will improve' wala option A sahi hoga.

questions.question: Invest in advanced analytics tools, and decision-making accuracy will increase across departments.
options: Advanced analytics tools are invested in so that decision-making accuracy increases.
If advanced analytics tools are invested in, decision-making accuracy will increase across departments.
Advanced analytics tools are invested in and decision-making accuracy increases.
Because analytics tools are invested in, decision-making accuracy increases.
questions.solution: Jab compound mein 'and' conjunction 'reason' 'result' ko joda ho, toh complex mein meaning same rakhne ke liye 'if' conjunction se banayenge, isliye 'If advanced analytics tools are invested in, decision-making accuracy will increase across departments' wala option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: If the management implements transparent policies, employee trust will strengthen.
options: Because management implements transparent policies, employee trust strengthens.
The management implements transparent policies while employee trust strengthens.
The management implements transparent policies and employee trust will strengthen.
The management implements transparent policies but employee trust strengthens.
questions.solution: Complex mein 'if' conjunction se 'reason' 'result' ko bataya hai, toh compound mein 'and' conjunction se 'reason' 'result' ko jodke aaya hoga, isliye complex to compound same meaning 'The management implements transparent policies and employee trust will strengthen' wala option C sahi hoga.

questions.question: The emergency alarm sounded, and the evacuation procedure was initiated immediately.
options: The emergency alarm sounded although evacuation procedure was initiated immediately.
If the emergency alarm sounded, evacuation procedure was initiated immediately.
The emergency alarm sounded and evacuation procedure was initiated immediately.
As soon as the emergency alarm sounded, the evacuation procedure was initiated immediately.
questions.solution: Jab compound mein 'and' conjunction lagake time ki baat ho, matlab 'jaise he kuch hua, yeh karna pada' iss type ka meaning aaye, toh complex mein 'when, as soon as' conjunction se banayenge, isliye 'As soon as the emergency alarm sounded, the evacuation procedure was initiated immediately' wala option D sahi hoga.

options: The inspection team arrived at the facility although they began conducting detailed safety assessments.
When the inspection team arrived at the facility, they began conducting detailed safety assessments.
Not only the inspection team arrived at the facility but also began conducting detailed safety assessments.
The inspection team arrived at the facility, so began conducting detailed safety assessments.
questions.solution: Jab compound mein 'and' conjunction lagake time ki baat ho, matlab 'jaise he kuch hua, yeh karna pada' iss type ka meaning aaye, toh complex mein 'when, as soon as' conjunction se banayenge, isliye 'When the inspection team arrived at the facility, they began conducting detailed safety assessments' wala option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: When the data verification process concluded successfully, the report was released to stakeholders.
options: The data verification process concluded successfully but the report was released to stakeholders.
Because the data verification process concluded successfully, the report was released to stakeholders.
The data verification process concluded successfully and the report was released to stakeholders.
After concluding the data verification process successfully, the report was released to stakeholders.
questions.solution: Sentence mein 'when' conjunction se pata chal raha ki complex hai, aur iska meaning hai 'jaise he verification khatam hua, report release ho gayi', toh time ki baat ho rahi, joki same meaning compound mein 'and' conjunction se aata hai, isliye 'The data verification process concluded successfully and the report was released to stakeholders' wala option C sahi hoga.

questions.question: I met a consultant and he specializes in international trade regulations.
options: I met a consultant who specializes in international trade regulations.
I met a consultant although he specializes in international trade regulations.
I met a consultant and he specializes in international trade regulations.
Because he specializes in international trade regulations, I met him.
questions.solution: Compound mein jab first clause ke noun ke liye dusra clause likha jaaye aur dono ko 'and' conjunction se joda jaaye, toh complex mein first clause ke noun ke liye adjectival clause banake likhte hai, isliye 'I met a consultant who specializes in international trade regulations' wala option A sahi hoga.

questions.question: The committee selected a candidate and she demonstrated exceptional leadership potential.
options: The committee selected a candidate although she demonstrated leadership potential.
She demonstrated exceptional leadership potential, so the committee selected her.
The committee selected a candidate who demonstrated exceptional leadership potential.
The committee selected a candidate and she demonstrated leadership potential.
questions.solution: Compound mein jab first clause ke noun ke liye dusra clause likha jaaye aur dono ko 'and' conjunction se joda jaaye, toh complex mein first clause ke noun ke liye adjectival clause banake likhte hai, isliye 'The committee selected a candidate who demonstrated exceptional leadership potential' wala option C sahi hoga.

questions.question: The organization recruited a professional who possesses extensive experience in crisis management.

The organization recruited a professional, so he possesses extensive experience in crisis management.
The organization recruited a professional because he possesses extensive experience in crisis management.
The organization recruited a professional while he possesses extensive experience in crisis management.
questions.solution: Jab complex mein first clause mein noun ke liye adjectival clause likha toh, compound mein 'and' se do clauses judke aaya hoga, isliye 'The organization recruited a professional and he possesses extensive experience in crisis management' wala option A sahi hoga.

questions.question: The network congestion was very severe, and therefore online services became temporarily unavailable.
options: The network congestion was very severe, so online services became temporarily unavailable.
The network congestion was very severe, but online services became temporarily unavailable.
Online services became temporarily unavailable when the network congestion was very severe.
The network congestion was so severe that online services became temporarily unavailable.
questions.solution: Agar compound mein 'very' ke sath 'and so/hence/therefore' likha ho toh, toh complex 'so…..that' conjunction se banayenge, isliye 'The network congestion was so severe that online services became temporarily unavailable' wala option D sahi hoga.

questions.question: The workload was very demanding, so employees experienced considerable professional burnout.
options: The workload was very demanding, and employees experienced considerable professional burnout.
Since the workload was very demanding, employees experienced considerable professional burnout.
Because of the demanding workload, employees experienced considerable professional burnout.
Employees experienced considerable professional burnout when the workload was very demanding.
questions.solution: Compound mein matlab hai 'workload demanding tha, isliye employees ne experience kiya burnout ko', toh option A galat hoga kyunki complex mein 'and' conjunction ka use nahi hota. Option C bhi galat hoga kyunki isme koi conjunction nahi hai 'because of' preposition hoti hai. compound mein matlab hai 'workload demanding tha, isliye employee ne experience kiya burnout' aur same compound wala meaning option B mein aa raha hai 'kyunki workload demanding tha, employees ne experience kiya burnout ko', isliye option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: The auditorium was so overcrowded that several participants remained standing throughout the conference.
options: The auditorium was overcrowded while participants remained standing throughout the conference.
Since the auditorium was overcrowded, several participants remained standing throughout the conference.
Because of the overcrowded auditorium, participants remained standing throughout the conference.
The auditorium was overcrowded and therefore several participants remained standing throughout the conference.
questions.solution: Agar compound mein 'very' ke sath 'and so/hence/therefore' likha ho toh, toh complex 'so…..that' conjunction se banate hai, toh complex to compound mein reverse ho jayega, isliye 'was overcrowded and therefore several participants' wala option D sahi hoga.

questions.question: As the committee recognized the urgency of regulatory reform, it expedited the approval process without further deliberation.
options: The committee recognized the urgency of regulatory reform and expedited the approval process without further deliberation.
Recognizing the urgency of regulatory reform, the committee expedited the approval process without further deliberation.
Having recognized the urgency of regulatory reform, the committee was expediting the approval process without further deliberation.
The committee's recognition of urgency of regulatory reform had led to the expedition of the approval process without further deliberation.
questions.solution: Complex to simple mein meaning aur tense change nahi hona chaiye aur simple mein ek hee clause aata hai, isliye option A galat hoga kyunki 'and' conjunction do clause ko jod rahi hai. option C bhi galat hoga kyunki isme 'was expediting' tense change kar diya. Option D bhi galat hoga kyunki 'had led' galat tense ka use hua hai, isliye option B sahi hoga kyunki isme tense aur meaning dono sahi hai.

questions.question: The sudden erosion of investor confidence triggered prolonged instability in regional financial markets.
options: Because investor confidence eroded suddenly, prolonged instability occurred in regional financial markets.
Investor confidence eroded suddenly while prolonged instability occurred in regional financial markets.
Investor confidence eroded suddenly and prolonged instability occurred in regional financial markets.
With investor confidence eroding suddenly, prolonged instability occurred in regional financial markets.
questions.solution: Option C galat hoga kyunki clause jodne ke liye 'and' conjunction ka use compound mein hota hai. option D mein 'occurred' ek hee main verb hai, matlab ek hee clause hai toh yeh simple sentence hoga isliye option D bhi galat hoga. option B bhi galat hoga kyunki 'while' yahan contradiction dikha raha hai. option A ka matlab hai 'kyunki achanak se investor confidence erode ho gaya tha, prolong instability aa gayi thi markets mein', toh option A ka meaning same simple sentence se hai, isliye option A sahi hoga.

questions.question: The analyst reviewed the projections carefully, and he presented a cautiously optimistic outlook.
options: Because the analyst reviewed the projections carefully, he presented a cautiously optimistic outlook.
The analyst reviewed the projections carefully, so presented a cautiously optimistic outlook.
After reviewing the projections carefully, the analyst presented a cautiously optimistic outlook.
The analyst's careful review of projections is resulting in the presentation of a cautiously optimistic outlook.
questions.solution: Option A aur B galat honge kyunki isme 'because' aur 'so' conjunction se do clause ko joda hai, lekin simple mein ek hee clause aata hai. option D bhi galat hoga kyunki 'is resulting' present tense kar diya jabki complex mein 'presented' past indefinite tense hai. option C ka matlab hai 'projection ko carefully review karne ke baad analyst ne present kiya optimistic outlook ko', toh option C se same compound wala meaning aa raha hai aur isme ek he clause hai, isliye option C sahi hoga.

questions.question: The institution's strategic restructuring enhanced operational flexibility across multiple departments.
options: The institution underwent strategic restructuring, and operational flexibility improved across multiple departments.
Because the institution underwent strategic restructuring, operational flexibility improved across multiple departments.
The institution underwent strategic restructuring to improve operational flexibility across multiple departments.
Strategic restructuring enhanced operational flexibility while multiple departments adjusted.
questions.solution: Compound sentence 'FANBOYS' coordinate conjunction se bante hai, isliye option B aur D galat honge kyunki 'because' aur 'while' subordinate conjunction hoti hai. option C bhi galat hoga kyunki bina conjunction ke simple sentence hote hai, isliye meaning, tense aur conjunction wise option A sahi hoga.

The infrastructure modernization demanded substantial investment, and significantly improved service reliability.
Because the infrastructure modernization demanded substantial investment, significantly improved service reliability.
The infrastructure modernization demanded substantial investment to improve service reliability significantly

The research team detected sampling inconsistencies so that it can revise the experimental methodology.
The research team's detection of sampling inconsistencies led to a revision of the experimental methodology.

Because the directive lacked procedural clarity, operational delays became inevitable across administrative units.
The directive lacked procedural clarity, so operational delays became inevitable across administrative units.
questions.solution: Complex to simple mein change karna hai, simple mein ek hee clause hote hai. option A, C aur D galat honge kyunki isme 'and', 'because' aur 'so' conjunction se do clause jud rahe hai. isliye meaning aur clause wise option B sahi hoga.

With commodity prices fluctuating persistently, uncertainty emerged among long-term investors.
Commodity prices fluctuated persistently so uncertainty emerged among long-term investors.

The negotiations reached an impasse and both delegations reassessed their diplomatic strategies.
Because the negotiations reached an impasse, both delegations reassessed their diplomatic strategies.
The impasse in negotiations will make both delegations reassess their diplomatic strategies.

Technological adoption accelerated rapidly and regulatory oversight evolved at a comparatively slower pace.
If technological adoption accelerated rapidly, regulatory oversight evolved slowly.
Technological adoption accelerated rapidly, but regulatory oversight evolved at a comparatively slower pace.

The committee reviewed the evidence carefully to reach a unanimous verdict.

The introduction of flexible work policies led to a significant improvement in employee satisfaction.
Because the organization introduced flexible work policies, employee satisfaction improved significantly.
Because of the introduction of flexible work policies, employee satisfaction will improve significantly.
questions.solution: Compound se simple jana hai. option A aur C galat honge kyunki 'so' se compound aur 'because' se complex sentence bante hai. option D mein 'will improve' future tense ka use kiya hai, aur compound mein 'improved' tense ka use hai, isliye option D galat hoga. jab kisi cheez ka result batana ho toh 'led to, resulted in' se connect karke simple bana sakte hai, isliye meaning wise option B sahi hoga.

Without diversifying its investment portfolio, the organization may face intensified long-term financial risks.
The organization fails to diversify its investment portfolio so long-term financial risks may intensify.
questions.solution: Complex se simple jana hai. option B aur D galat honge kyunki 'because' aur 'so' conjunction se do clause jud rahe hai. option A bhi galat hoga kyunki compound sentence ke according iska meaning galat hai. isliye sahi meaning ke according option C sahi hoga.

questions.question: Not only is the policy financially sustainable but it is also environmentally responsible in the long run.

In spite of being financially sustainable, the policy is environmentally responsible in the long run.
The policy is financially sustainable although it is not environmentally responsible in the long run.
The policy is both financially sustainable and environmentally responsible in the long run.

The candidate must verify all credentials carefully while discrepancies emerge during evaluation.

Option mein 'avoiding discrepancies' ka matlab hoga 'discrepancies avoid karte hue', joki compound ke according galat hoga, isliye option A galat hoga. aur option C ka matlab 'evaluation ke duaran discrepancies ko rokne karne ke liye', isliye meaning ke according option C sahi hoga.

The operational constraints were severe and the project team could not adhere to the original timeline.
Because of the operational constraints, the project team may not adhere to the original timeline.
The operational constraints were too severe so the project team could not adhere to the original timeline.

Technicians were executing routine maintenance checks and the system failure occurred.
The system failure occurred because technicians were executing routine maintenance checks.
The system failure had occurred during the execution of routine maintenance checks by technicians.
